title: Popescu's local problem is resolvable at a regular prime with separable residue field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $A$ a $k$-algebra of finite presentation, $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ a homomorphism of $k$-algebras and $\mathfrak q\subset\Lambda$ a prime ideal, and let $\mathfrak h_A=\sqrt{H_{A/k}\Lambda}$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. Assume (1) $\Lambda$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; (2) $\mathfrak q$ is minimal over $\mathfrak h_A$ (a minimal element of the set of primes of $\Lambda$ containing $\mathfrak h_A$); (3) the localization $\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]; (4) the residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$, a field extension of $k$ via $k\to\Lambda$, is separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Then $k\to A\to\Lambda\supset\mathfrak q$ can be resolved [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FE (lemma-resolve-special), Section 07FB (section-separable); its proof uses Lemmas lemma-find-sequence, lemma-ogoma, lemma-desingularize-lifting-apply and the local tricks of Section 07F6
